header.title: Line Chart
header.subtitle: Multi-series line chart built on Recharts LineChart. Renders one line per series with a shared Legend and Tooltip. The formatTooltip callback receives both the value and the series key, enabling per-series formatting.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: The chart wraps Recharts primitives in a ResponsiveContainer. Each series in the series[] prop renders one Line element. The Legend is always rendered and resolves labels from series[].label.

single.title: Single series
single.description: A single-element series array renders one line. The Legend is still rendered using the label from that entry.

multi.title: Multi-series
multi.description: Pass two or more objects in series[]. Each entry provides its own key, color, and label. The Legend is rendered automatically using those labels.

formatters.title: With formatters — key-aware
formatters.description: formatTooltip receives (value, key), enabling different formatting per series. This is the key difference from AreaChart and BarChart, whose formatTooltip only receives the value.

colors.title: Semantic colors
colors.description: Always reference system tokens — var(--accent), var(--success), var(--warning) — so lines adapt to theme and accent changes automatically.

localized.title: Localized labels
localized.description: Pass localised strings as series[].label. The Legend and Tooltip both display those labels — the raw key is never shown to users.

loading.title: Loading and error states
loading.description: The same loading and error pattern documented on the Area Chart page applies here. Use ChartSkeleton with type="line" for the correct skeleton shape.

props.title: Props
props.description: data, xKey, and series are required. All other props are optional.

seriesProps.title: Series
seriesProps.description: Each object in the series array describes one line.

anatomy.responsiveContainer: Responsive wrapper — fills parent width, uses the height prop
anatomy.lineChart: Recharts LineChart root — receives data array and margin config
anatomy.cartesianGrid: Horizontal grid lines — uses chartGridProps from @lib/charts
anatomy.xAxis: Bottom axis — renders tick labels from xKey; uses chartAxisProps
anatomy.yAxis: Left axis — renders tick labels via formatY; uses chartAxisProps
anatomy.tooltip: Hover overlay — formatter receives (value, key) for per-series formatting
anatomy.legend: Auto-rendered legend — resolves item labels from series[].label; uses chartLegendStyle
anatomy.lines: One Line element per series entry — monotone curve, no dots, active dot on hover

multi.note: Each series provides its own key, color, and label. The Legend is rendered automatically using those labels.

localized.note: Pass t('series.revenue') at the call site. The chart never calls t() internally — labels arrive ready-translated.

props.data: Array of data objects. Each object must contain the xKey field and every series key.
props.xKey: Key of the field used for X-axis labels.
props.series: Array of series descriptors. Each entry defines one line.
props.formatY: Formats Y-axis tick labels. Receives a number, returns a string.
props.formatTooltip: Formats tooltip values. Receives (value: number, key: string) — use the key to apply per-series formatting.
props.height: Chart height in pixels. Defaults to 240.

seriesProps.key: Field name in the data array to use as this line's values.
seriesProps.color: Stroke color. Use CSS custom properties for theme compatibility.
seriesProps.label: Human-readable label shown in the Legend and Tooltip. Optional — falls back to the raw key.
